messages:
Mira: FYI Hermes LoRA merge + int4 quant shows currency microformat stripping in outputs.
Alex: hmm, example?
Mira: Input: "Refund $12.50 to customer" -> Output: "Refund 12.5 to customer" (lost $ sign and trimmed trailing zero).
Jin: that's bad. only after merging lora+quant? baseline model ok?
Mira: baseline float32 intact. reproduce: merge + q4 inference pipeline triggers it.
Sam: can you paste the exact model tag and inference command?
Mira: model: hermes-base-lora-merge:v23 + quant profile q4_gleu.
Mira: local repro command: 
``` 
python -m rbw.infer --model hermes-base-lora-merge:v23 --quant q4_gleu --prompt "Refund $12.50 to customer"
```
Alex: I can repro locally. tokenization / embedding probs around "$" drop a lot after merge+quant.
Jin: could be LoRA weight bleed into embedding matrix at merge time. Did we run merge with embed-bias fused?
Mira: merge command used default (merge --skip-embed-bias=false). I'll re-run with --skip-embed-bias=true and re-eval.
Sam: also queued a focused quickpack: tests/quickpacks/hermes_currency_smoke.json against float32, merged-fp32, merged-q4 to get diffs.
qa-bot: quickpack queued: hermes_currency_smoke -> run id qp-8872 (ETA ~8m).
Mira: qp-8872 results: float32 clear pass, merged-fp32 slight variance, merged-q4 fail on currency microformats (missing $ / dropped trailing zeros). attaching diffs in tracker.
Alex: can you dump top-k token probs at the dollar position for both traces? e.g.
```
pos 3 (float32): {'$':0.42, '':0.38, 'USD':0.05, ...}
pos 3 (q4): {'$':0.08, '':0.7, 'USD':0.02, ...}
```
Jin: that looks like embedding shift + quant noise. If $ token prob collapses, downstream detokenization loses symbol.
Mira: quick hack: enabling prefix-caching and disabling grouped-quant reduced failure rate in smoke runs (not a fix).
Sam: for the customer (Hermes payments) we should pin their Dedicated rollout to float32 or merged-fp32 and block q4 variants until fix.
Mira: filed RED-ML-1298 with logs, qp diffs, top-k dumps, and a minimal repro script. pinging @Alex @Jin for triage.
deploy-bot: rolled back hermes-lora-merge:v23-q4 from canary -> staging per request.
Alex: ack, will take ownership of investigation tomorrow morning. likely action items: verify merge tool flags, re-run merge with skip-embed-bias, run per-layer quant sims, and produce a minimal failing unit test.
Mira: adding note to the customer thread: recommend pinned float32 Dedicated for money fields, ETA for root-cause TBD. Thanks all :thumbsup:
